bullets.text: In Ambattur, a girl died in a lorry accident in front of her mother, prompting public demands for road repairs and traffic regulation that the office should monitor.
Chennai received heavy overnight rain causing waterlogging and school closures, and the office should track GCC complaints and relief efforts.
Power supply will be suspended in Velachery areas like Rettaipillaiyar Koil Street for maintenance, and the office should watch for smooth restoration.
Moderate rain continued across Chennai including Velachery since early morning, and the office should monitor civic waterlogging complaints.
A pension adalat will be held on the 20th to resolve grievances for Thiruvallur district pensioners, and the office should watch proceedings.
The ARS Energy Gummidipoondi plant is back on auction at a reduced reserve price of Rs 190.75 crore, which the district team should monitor.
Five library department officers were suspended over fake and AI-generated book procurement complaints, and the portfolio team should review procurement protocols.
Chennai residents are urging the civic body to intensify fogging due to a surge in mosquito menace, and the office should coordinate with authorities.
The library book procurement case deepened with 70,674 books sealed following court scrutiny, and the office should monitor developments closely.
